goal: Reduce node memory usage by eliminating alignment padding for every tracked block on 64-bit systems
Saves roughly 8 MB of resident RAM for every one million blocks
agreement: Strong support with no open objections
Verified the 8-byte struct reduction on 64-bit builds with no serialization downside (l0rinc)
Noted the change is very low risk and saves memory on Windows builds (jonatack, sedited)
Argued compiler checks and independent field layout prevent aggregate initialization bugs (maflcko)
Asked for an explanation of safety regarding memory layout dependencies, which was answered (stickies-v)

categories.name: validation
why: P4 because it is a micro-optimization saving around 8 MB across one million blocks
The memory reduction has negligible impact on overall validation performance
